page.overview:
Who is Arsen Demo?

Arsen Demo was a soldier of House Atreides.

Arsen Demo was approached by the Prisoner in Hannivar's. He told them that he was stationed with his unit in Harko Village, where over time he came to be regarding by House Harkonnen with hateful indifference. He also told them what he knew of the Maas Kharet, such as their stealing of water and their hatred of the Fremen despite claiming to be Fremen themselves. He warned that while their leader Nahla was not a Sayyadina, she was very powerful and had a strong hold on her believers.
